status: Core army selection/per-race quantity/source reuse directly instructed. Pool arrangement and composite/history/count routing are disclosed implementation choices. Algorithm design; troop capability/body-role fit, source/body bindings and executor remain configuration.

confirmed: Warlord spins an army race or Multi Race. Multi Race spins 1–3 race groups, then their races.
Troop identity descends to types such as Pocong; Dragon stops at Dragon without body form or element.
Each selected army race gets one independent army quantity spin.
Army quantity differs by race and reuses the existing Slayer or Vampire number wheels.
authoredInterpretations: Army Type uses the twenty-two canonical family options plus one Multi Race sector. Goblin/Orc/Troll resolve within their existing grouped family; Primordial descends through its shared identity selector.
Direct Vampire troops use the six-value Vampire count; other troops use the matching Slayer quantity profile and canonical assignments.

Multi Race groups are distinct: exclude families already consumed by this army identity chain, including nested origins/hosts/components, using separate army history. The commander’s race remains available.
Other identity paths reuse Slayer’s identity-only routes and classification rules, except the explicit Dragon stop. Dragon uses its existing apex assignment without a form draw.

A composite troop identity receives one count for its whole group; its host/origin/components do not receive extra counts. A nested Vampire component still contributes its Slayer rank for composite classification.

quantityContract.resolveProfileContract: Use canonical Slayer route default and quantityAssignments for applicable identity results; latest selector assignment wins. Siluman uses its single selected animal rank. Anime NPC is common, MC uses genre then applicable Sci-fi role. Wrappers use min(7,max(minimumRank,hardestChildRank+promotion)). Apply these classification rules with the Warlord Dragon cap; never run Slayer victim-count reward resolution.
quantityContract.resultProjectionContract: Quantity views expose sourceOutcomeId, numeric value, troop label, baseWeight and probability only. Do not project Slayer strengthBonus or Vampire effects/followupWheelId/narration/influence. Do not invoke resolveSlayerVictimCount or feeding reward dispatch.

contracts.order: Actual Warlord/reaction -> Army Type/reaction -> Multi Race only: one 1–3 group-count spin/reaction -> for each group in order: identity-only race path/reactions -> one race-specific Army Quantity/reaction -> commit source-owned group -> after all groups Backstory.
contracts.troopIdentity: Only allowed identityRoutes/selectors execute in troop-reference mode. No troop race reward package, stat/mastery/power/weapon/armor, army/follower count, Takeover, Size or secondary Archetype event is imported. Elemental/Golem element is material identity only; Dragon never spins form or element.
contracts.history: Use separate usedArmyFamilyIds within the Warlord invocation, never the commander’s usedRaceFamilyIds. Commit a family before its identity children. Multi Race groups exclude every already-consumed army family; nested wrapper chains share that army history. Freeze commander gate/race history unchanged.
contracts.quantity: Exactly one quantity spin per complete root troop group, not per identity component, nested selector or individual soldier. Single race has one count; Multi Race N has N counts even when N=1. Resolve that group’s identity first, then use the source count profile and its exact base weights.
contracts.profileSelection: Use canonical Slayer route default and quantityAssignments for applicable identity results; latest selector assignment wins. Siluman uses its single selected animal rank. Anime NPC is common, MC uses genre then applicable Sci-fi role. Wrappers use min(7,max(minimumRank,hardestChildRank+promotion)). Apply these classification rules with the Warlord Dragon cap; never run Slayer victim-count reward resolution.
contracts.vampireOverride: Only a direct root Lelembut with imported-type vampire uses vampire-victim-count. Re-label count as troops and project victimCount to value. Skeleton/Zombie origins, Symbiote hosts and Hybrid components containing Vampire use their canonical Slayer rank when classifying the one composite troop group.
contracts.sourceProjection: Quantity views expose sourceOutcomeId, numeric value, troop label, baseWeight and probability only. Do not project Slayer strengthBonus or Vampire effects/followupWheelId/narration/influence. Do not invoke resolveSlayerVictimCount or feeding reward dispatch.
contracts.zero: Zero is a valid empty troop group with a recorded identity and count; retain it and its reaction without reroll or replacing its race. Total army is the sum of this invocation’s group counts; all zero means zero soldiers.
contracts.reward: The army is the declared benefit. No Warlord personal stat/power/mastery bonus or loot was specified. Troop abilities and battlefield contribution need separate capability profiles, never implicit per-soldier full racial spin results.
contracts.existingArmies: Create Warlord-owned army records alongside earlier Goblin/Orc armies; do not overwrite their count, Bos/Kacung position or source. Warlord commands its own newly selected groups without another Bos/Kacung roll. Follower records remain separate.
contracts.probability: Army Type: twenty-three baseWeight1 sectors (twenty-two families plus Multi Race). Multi group count:1/2/3 equal. Identity selectors retain canonical odds; count views retain exact Slayer profiles or Vampire5:4:3:3:2:1. Reused Slayer outcomes retain their existing >=5% odds. No new rarity or quantity multiplier. Authorized active Equalizer keeps its established final eligible-odds precedence.
contracts.context: Stack actual Warlord, selected mode, group count, troop identity path and actual group quantities. Narrator reacts after every actual spin. Future groups/results remain unknown; rewrite feeding/victim labels as pasukan. Short Gen Z captions, no joke explanation or implicit funny tag.
contracts.ledger: Freeze rule/source versions, projected selector/count pools and final odds, mode/group-count, each identity tree and count result, usedArmyFamilyIds, group ordinals/source IDs and saved continuation. Commit each group once by runId/WarlordInvocationId/groupOrdinal/quantitySpinId. Replay/media retry restores committed groups and resumes unfinished steps without redraw, duplicated army or counted components.
contracts.return: Return to Backstory only after all requested group identities/counts/commits/reactions. Normal owner Backstory, Size, main stats, equipment, powers and final bonuses remain unchanged.
contracts.runtime: Design contract only; final army capability/control/body fit and executor remain configuration. Siluman resolves one identity-only animal from its twelve-choice wheel.

followupSpinCountFormula.multi: 1 Army Type + 1 group-count + sum(1 family root + identity follow-ups + 1 quantity) for N groups
